newsitem.title: FRANCE: GOLF-JOHNSON CONTINUES RECORD BREAKING RUN.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-JOHNSON CONTINUES RECORD BREAKING RUN.

text.p: Britain's Trish Johnson continued her record-breaking spree when she added a 68 to her opening 62 in the women's French Open on Saturday.
With a 16-under-par 130, a European women's Tour record for 36 holes, Johnson led by a runaway nine strokes from Scotland's Gillian Stewart and defending champion Marie-Laure de Lorenzi from France.
Johnson, whose opening 62 was a Tour record for 18 holes, said: "I didn't hit the ball as close to the flags today because it was so cold and windy but I will continue to attack the course tomorrow."
Johnson carried on where she left off with birdies on the first two holes and carded six birdies in the round. Her only bogey in two days came at the 121-yard 14th where she holed-in-one on Friday.
"I hit the same club, an eight iron, but I almost duffed it and my ball was miles short of the green," she said.
